title: Flaky on macOS: VoiceOver side-panel return reads the usage hint instead of 'Finish' (voiceover-side-panel-return)
body:
## Flake

The macOS native leg's accessibility smoke (`Runic.Desktop.WebViewSmoke --side-panel`, step "Check what screen readers read in the embedded window") sometimes fails in `voiceover-side-panel-return`:

```text
PROBE REQUEST shift-tab
ACCESSIBILITY pressed Shift+Tab.
  event FocusChanged from '' (AXGroup): AXFocusedUIElementChanged
FAIL           voiceover-side-panel-return: VoiceOver did not say 'Finish'; it said: You are currently on a button. To click this button, press Control-Option-Space.
  focused after the return: AXButton () 'Finish'
```

Focus does move to the page's `Finish`
